query: What Did You Wish For? {dear} drops onto the window seat beside you with two mugs of cocoa. "So," {they} say{s}. "Lantern Night. What did you wish for? You can tell me. I won't tell the lake." Tell {them} the truth You tell {them}. {dear} goes quiet for a moment, and then bumps {their} shoulder against yours and doesn't move it away. Saying it out loud was harder than writing it. "If I tell you, it won't come true." {dear} groans, and spends the rest of the cocoa guessing, each guess more ridiculous than the last. You laugh so hard you spill yours.
